observations: SLES and Cocamidopropyl Betaine form the main cleanser system.
Hydrolyzed Keratin, Panthenol, two silicones and cationic guar create a coherent deposition cluster.
The current official formula is the canonical classification source; a retailer tail-list variant is not merged into this formula version.
The 3% wording names a Panthenol moisture complex, not 3% pure Panthenol.

cleansingStrength.rationale: The official German formula supports ordinary moderate cleansing from an SLES/betaine cleanser system.

supportingSignals.observation: SLES and betaine form the main cleanser system.

counterSignals.observation: Active-matter levels and comparative cleansing data are absent.
counterSignals.inference: The classification remains bounded and does not establish individual performance magnitude.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Dimethicone, Amodimethicone, cationic guar and refatting agents support moderate shampoo deposition and slip.

supportingSignals.observation: Dimethicone, Amodimethicone, cationic guar and several refatting agents are present.
supportingSignals.inference: Moderate shampoo deposition and slip are formula-coherent.

counterSignals.observation: No combing or deposition measurement isolates the shampoo.
counterSignals.inference: The classification remains bounded and does not establish individual performance magnitude.

focusPrimary.rationale: General curl-positioned care is the closest allowed direct property: regular cleansing is paired with several conditioning and film-forming cues.

supportingSignals.observation: Regular cleansing is paired with Dimethicone, Amodimethicone, cationic guar, Panthenol and Hydrolyzed Keratin.
supportingSignals.inference: General curl-care product focus is formula-coherent within the current taxonomy.

counterSignals.observation: The taxonomy has no dedicated curl-focus value and no curl-specific finished-product endpoint is captured.
counterSignals.inference: The classification remains bounded and does not establish individual performance magnitude.

focusSecondary.rationale: Silicones support surface smoothing/shine and Hydrolyzed Keratin is a temporary film cue, so shine plus bounded repair are coherent secondary focuses.

supportingSignals.observation: Silicones support surface smoothing; hydrolyzed keratin is a temporary film cue.
supportingSignals.inference: Shine and bounded repair secondary focuses are formula-coherent.

counterSignals.observation: No shampoo-only shine, breakage or repair endpoint is captured.
counterSignals.inference: The classification remains bounded and does not establish individual performance magnitude.

usageRole.rationale: The official formula supports a regular wash role for the intended curl-care context; fine or buildup-prone users may prefer alternating use.

supportingSignals.observation: Ordinary cleansing coexists with several depositors.
supportingSignals.inference: Regular use is a coherent product role.

counterSignals.observation: Fine or buildup-prone users may prefer alternating use.
counterSignals.inference: The classification remains bounded and does not establish individual performance magnitude.

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: The exact formula/positioning are resolved for this shadow audit, but the product does not deliberately target dry, tight, itchy, flaky or sensitive scalp comfort with a coherent specialist route. This means no specialist scalp-comfort target, not that the product is unsuitable for every sensitive user.

supportingSignals.observation: The exact formula/positioning are sufficient for this shadow audit, but no exact-product evidence establishes a dedicated dry, tight, itchy, flaky or sensitive scalp-comfort target with a coherent specialist route.
supportingSignals.inference: The direct product property is not_targeted. This does not mean the product is unsuitable for every sensitive user.

counterSignals.observation: Generic gentle, dermatological, anti-dandruff, oil-control, hair-care, volume, shine or repair positioning is not by itself a scalp-comfort target under the approved gates.
counterSignals.inference: Sensitive-profile suitability is derived separately from cleansing strength, scalp oiliness, dandruff support and exposure preferences.

dandruffSupport.rationale: The complete exact formula does not contain the MVP anti-dandruff support ingredients Piroctone Olamine or Climbazole; dry flakes remain a dry/sensitive-scalp route, not dandruff support.

supportingSignals.observation: The complete INCI contains no Piroctone Olamine or Climbazole.
supportingSignals.inference: No conventional anti-dandruff support route is established for the MVP database value.

counterSignals.observation: Ordinary cleansing may remove loose dry flakes, but that is not a dandruff-support ingredient route.
counterSignals.inference: Route this to dry/sensitive-scalp fit rather than dandruff support.
